A VPN (virtual private network) is a service that sends your internet traffic through a protected, encrypted link to another computer before it reaches the website you want. Think of it as a private tunnel between your device and the wider internet.

It helps in two main ways. It hides what you do from others on the same network, such as public Wi-Fi at a café or airport. It also hides your real location from the sites you visit, since they see the VPN's address instead of yours.

A VPN is not a magic shield. It won't protect you from scams, viruses or sites you sign in to, and the VPN company itself can see your traffic, so pick one you trust. People also use VPNs for work, to safely reach their office files from home.

VPN (virtual private network) ek aisi service hai jo aapka internet traffic ek surakshit, scrambled raste se doosre computer tak bhejti hai, phir aapki chuni hui website tak. Isse aise samjho jaise aapke device aur internet ke beech ek private surang.

Iske do bade fayde hain. Cafe ya airport ke public Wi-Fi par doosre log dekh nahi paate ki aap kya kar rahe ho. Websites ko aapki asli location nahi dikhti, kyunki unhe VPN ka address dikhta hai.

Par VPN koi jaadui dhaal nahi hai. Ye scams ya viruses se nahi bachata, aur VPN company aapka traffic dekh sakti hai, isliye bharosemand company chuno. Kaafi log ise kaam ke liye bhi use karte hain, ghar se office ki files tak safely pahunchne ke liye.
